code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color in set(x for row in grid for x in row) - {bg}:
        candidates = []
        for r1 in range(h):
            for r2 in range(r1 + 1, h):
                for c1 in range(w):
                    for c2 in range(c1 + 1, w):
                        nr, nc = r2 - r1 + 1, c2 - c1 + 1
                        area = nr * nc
                        row_counts = [sum(grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)) for r in range(r1, r2 + 1)]
                        col_counts = [sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(r1, r2 + 1)) for c in range(c1, c2 + 1)]
                        count = sum(row_counts)
                        if (count >= 4 and count / area >= 0.62
                                and min(row_counts) >= max(1, nc * 0.5)
                                and min(col_counts) >= max(1, nr * 0.5)):
                            candidates.append((area, count, count / area, r1, r2, c1, c2))
        candidates.sort(reverse=True)
        used = set()
        for area, count, density, r1, r2, c1, c2 in candidates:
            points = {(r, c) for r in range(r1, r2 + 1) for c in range(c1, c2 + 1) if grid[r][c] == color}
            fresh = points - used
            if len(fresh) >= 4 and len(fresh) / area >= 0.62:
                for r in range(r1, r2 + 1):
                    for c in range(c1, c2 + 1):
                        out[r][c] = color
                used |= points
    return out
'''
